result.brief: 提出免训练上下文调度 ReCAP，为长时程机器人视频世界模型保留初始场景锚点与近期视觉-动作块、驱逐陈旧历史，提升预测保真度与效率。
result.reason: Training-free context scheduling for autoregressive robot video world models with discrete visual tokens; improves long-horizon action-conditioned video prediction, directly addressing world-model memory and tokenizer-based latents.
